description: This file manages the display and permissions for test requirement specifications within the TestLink project management tool. It initializes session variables, checks user rights, sets up the GUI context, and renders a template for requirement management.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP class used to create generic object containers for GUI context and other data.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user rights for viewing or modifying requirement specifications based on the test project context and user session.
